# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on the Skia m148 engine. This release bundles the Skia m132–m148 engine upgrade, variable font and palette support, animated WebP encoding, and a reworked singleton lifecycle. It is a breaking release — review the changes below before upgrading from v3.

## Breaking Changes

- **new SKFont() typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty, not null** — Upstream m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. new SKFont().MeasureText("Hello") now returns 0 and draws nothing. Pass an explicit typeface: new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default). Detect the unset state via font.Typeface.IsEmpty instead of a null check. ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **new SKPaint().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Default, not null** — new SKPaint().Typeface is non-null. Text still works out of the box, but code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect 'no typeface set' no longer fires. Use paint.Typeface.IsEmpty or drop the check.
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName returns Default (not null) for missing families on Android** — All platforms now consistently return SKTypeface.Default for an unknown family. For strict null semantics, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name) which still returns null on no match.
- **SKStream.Move(long) now throws OverflowException and is obsolete** — The native offset is 32-bit. The Move(long) overload now uses a checked cast; out-of-range offsets throw OverflowException and the overload is marked [Obsolete]. Use Move(int) with a validated value.
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts on Vulkan 1.0 (was: returns null)** — Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1. Passing a 1.0 instance or leaving MaxAPIVersion at 0 causes SK_ABORT (process termination, not a catchable exception). Set apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on VkApplicationInfo and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion. Hardware that is strictly 1.0-only cannot use Ganesh Vulkan.
- **GRVkBackendContextNative: five interop fields removed** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice are removed. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions, and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures. Delete the other assignments.
- **GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost value-equality; GRVkImageInfo property type renamed** — GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo no longer implements IEquatable and the == / != operators are removed — use field-by-field comparison. GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo is now typed as GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo (capitalisation change). Recompile to pick up these changes.
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed** — The protected setter is removed. Subclasses must use the constructor parameter or override the property getter.
- **SKPaint text/font members are now compile errors** — The legacy text-drawing properties on SKPaint (TextSize, Typeface, etc.) deprecated in v3 now emit compile errors. Move these to SKFont. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))

## Engine

- **Skia m148 engine, spanning m132–m148** — The bundled Skia engine advances from 3.x's milestone to m148, incorporating the m132, m147, and m148 milestones along with two chrome/m147 upstream bug-fix syncs. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081))

## API Surface

- **Variable font and color font palette support** — Variable font axes, named instances, and color font palette enumeration and selection are now accessible through SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding** — SKWebpEncoder now supports creating multi-frame animated WebP files via SKWebpAnimEncoder. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **SKStream.GetData for zero-copy access** — SKStream.GetData() returns an SKData wrapping the stream's buffer without copying, useful for memory-mapped or in-memory streams. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **SKSamplingOptions overloads for SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface** — SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface now accept an SKSamplingOptions parameter, giving control over the quality/speed trade-off when blitting surfaces. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **HarfBuzzSharp: HBColor struct and API additions** — Added HBColor for proper hb_color_t representation, missing API wrappers, and naming-convention fixes across the HarfBuzzSharp surface. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKPixmap/SKBitmap pixel-access offsets corrected** — GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride and the correct axis for the (x, y) offset, fixing silent data corruption on non-tightly-packed bitmaps. ([#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148))
- **SKPath finalizer crash fixed** — When an SKPathBuilder was garbage-collected before its SKPath, the path's finalizer could crash. Ownership is now tracked correctly. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 resolved** — The WinUI native projection DLL was absent for .NET 9 consumers; the package now correctly bundles the required asset. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))
- **Default typeface resolution moved to managed layer** — Resolving a null typeface to the platform default now happens in managed code, restoring consistent text-measurement behavior across platforms including Android API 36+. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton lifecycle reworked** — SKObject singletons are now tracked with weak references and re-created on demand, eliminating use-after-free crashes on app restart and reducing GC pressure. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Native-compat gate moved to SkiaApi cctor** — The native library compatibility check now runs in the SkiaApi class constructor, making load failures easier to diagnose. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic and Tizen native assets** — Native builds for Linux Bionic (Android NDK sysroot) and Tizen x64/arm64 are now included in the packages. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **WASM: dropped pre-.NET 8 Emscripten builds** — Emscripten builds for .NET 6 and .NET 7 are no longer included. The minimum WASM target is .NET 8. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **Apple platform TFMs corrected** — Library packages use versioned TFMs (e.g. ios26.0) and app packages use unversioned ones (e.g. ios), aligning with .NET Apple TFM conventions. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## Security

- **Native dependency updates** — Bundled expat updated to 2.8.1, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, harfbuzz to 14.2.0, freetype to 2.14.3, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, libpng to 1.6.58, and libexpat to 2.7.5, addressing known CVEs. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 ships in this release with variable font support, color font palette APIs, a new HBColor struct for hb_color_t, and expanded API wrappers.
